title: Casabianca Cycling
subtitle: Ecommerce
summary: Exploring a unique opportunity in Colombia: Cycling. After picking up 5 years of expertise on ecommerce saas, I decided to open a Cycling and Athletic Apparel Store. I design every single product and made the online shop and admin from scratch.

benefits.label: Product Design in Photoshop
benefits.description: I design the cycling apparel in Photoshop with a great set of mockups. With this tool, we can really get a real sense of how the products will look like in real life.

benefits.label: Shop created with Vue.js
benefits.description: No questions when choosing the framework and language. In this case, I used Nuxt.js and Vue to create a minimal and awesome online shop.

benefits.label: Using Database as a Service
benefits.description: I'm using Strapi for my Database as a service. Strapi is an open source Javascript framework that enables you to create APIs in seconds.

title: Frida - Real Estate Assistant
subtitle: Real Estate
summary: Frida is all you need in a real estate assistant. Frida automates all of your sales and marketing efforts, organizes your properties, lets you share them with your contacts, and helps you close more business.

benefits.label: Vue 3 + Vite.js + Github Copilot
benefits.description: Using the latest Vue version, Vite and Naive UI to make this app fast and reliable.

benefits.label: Directus as Database
benefits.description: Directus is a headless CMS that lets you create a database in seconds. Great tool for small projects and open source.

benefits.label: Full Figma Prototype
benefits.description: Full prototype and components in Figma. Created a full prototype to maintain and develop product initiatives easier.

title: Hi There
subtitle: Lead Generation Tool
summary: Hi there is a dead simple widget to communicate with your clients, on their preferred channels. You can choose what services you use, select if you want to capture leads, and send contacts to your databases.

benefits.label: Full Stack Javascript
benefits.description: Using the latest full stack javascript stack, I created a couple of micro-services to deliver minimal widgets to sites.

benefits.label: Directus Database
benefits.description: Using Directus cloud, saving a lot of time in dev ops. They have a great paid version of a Database as a service.

benefits.label: Figma and Untitled UI
benefits.description: Full prototype and components in Figma. Created a full prototype to maintain and develop product initiatives easier.

title: Amplified
subtitle: Automation Tool for Shopify
summary: The Full Automation tool for Shopify. From cart recovery to broadcast campaigns, customers can send email and SMS messages.

benefits.label: Using Vue 3 and Vite.js
benefits.description: Using the latest Vue version, Vite and Naive UI to make this app fast and reliable.

benefits.label: Complex app, simple code
benefits.description: With Vue 3, we were able to take out the complexity of a full automation tool and deliver great and simple code that is actually readable.

benefits.label: Complete prototype in Figma
benefits.description: Complete prototype and components with navigation in Figma. We use it to organize our designs and product initiatives.

title: Sales Pop
subtitle: Sales Conversion Tool
summary: Salespop is a simple application built for Shopify that promotes sales through Social Proof and Urgency.

benefits.label: Product Design Figma
benefits.description: Complete prototype and components with navigation in Figma. We use it to organize our designs and product initiatives.

benefits.label: Nuxt.js for Frontend
benefits.description: No questions when choosing the framework and language. In this case, we used Nuxt.js and Vue to create a minimal and awesome product.

benefits.label: Ruby on Rails for Backend
benefits.description: We used Ruby on Rails to create the backend of the app. We used the Shopify API to connect to the Shopify Store.

title: Codesign Studio
subtitle: Digital Agency
summary: We created a modern digital agency that provided Coding, Design, and Marketing services to SMBs in Colombia, LATAM, and the US.

benefits.label: Design and Consulting
benefits.description: We implemented a design and consulting method based on Design Thinking to create unique digital experiences.

benefits.label: Full Stack Development
benefits.description: From backend to frontend, we provided full-stack programming services. We used Javascript, HTML, SASS, and PHP.

benefits.label: Inbound Marketing
benefits.description: We specialized in Inbound Marketing and received a Hubspot inbound certification for the agency.

title: Printa Delivery
subtitle: Printing Service
summary: Printa Delivery is a complete printing service for Designers and Architects. People can easily print complex projects and get them delivered.

benefits.label: Complete Branding Book
benefits.description: Complete branding book with logos, colors, typography, and many more made with Adobe Illustrator.

benefits.label: Platform and Brand Design
benefits.description: We designed and tested the platform on Invision. We made emphasis on the mobile version to make designers lives a lot easier.

benefits.label: Coding and Maintenance
